findings.passage: Voter ID is not a new concept; we already require IDs for a multitude of seemingly lesser reasons than voting. Why wouldn't we require ID for voting? This amendment ensures the common sense status quo continues under the protection of our Constitution.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name after voting for SJR 2, the voter ID constitutional amendment. He says ID is already required for many lesser purposes and the amendment keeps the current rule.

findings.passage: This amendment is as simple as it comes. This will not decrease voter participation or undermine future elections.
findings.note: Second quote in the same release: he says the amendment will not lower participation and cites turnout figures; the release also says current state-law ID exemptions are not affected.
